y-m-23-08.title: Ukwenza ama-decimal lapho ukuphindeka kuqala sekwephuzile
y-m-23-08.goal: Hlukanisa izingxenyana lapho, uma zibhalwe njenge-decimal, ingxenye yangaphambili iphela futhi ingxenye yangemuva iyaphindeka, futhi uklame wena izingxenyana eziningana ezinjalo ukuthola ukuthi abahlukanisi bazo bafana ngani.
y-m-23-08.material: Uma izingxenyana zibhalwa njenge-decimal, ezinye ziphindeka kusukela endaweni yokuqala ye-decimal, njengo-1/3 = 0.333…; ezinye, njengo-1/6 = 0.1666…, zinogu-1 endaweni yokuqala ongasiyona ingxenye yokuphindeka futhi u-6 uphindeka kusukela endaweni yesibili. Kukhona nama-decimal aphela, njengo-1/4 = 0.25. Kulo msebenzi, uphatha kuphela izingxenyana u-a/b lapho u-a < b ≤ 60.
y-m-23-08.thinking.0: Ukuqagela ubudlelwano phakathi kwesakhiwo sokuhlukanisayo kwengxenyana nomumo we-decimal yayo
y-m-23-08.thinking.2: Ukuthola ukuthi izibonelo ozenzile zifana ngani nokuqagela ukuthi kungani
y-m-23-08.s.s1.prompt: Uma izingxenyana zibhalwa njenge-decimal, yiziphi eziqala ukuphindeka hhayi endaweni yokuqala ye-decimal kodwa ngemuva kwayo? (Ezinjengo-1/6 = 0.1666…, lapho idijithi elilodwa noma amabili angaphambili engeyona ingxenye yokuphindeka.) Khetha zonke.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.hint.0: Sebenza ingxenyana ngayinye ngokuhlukanisa kuze kufike ezindaweni ezine ze-decimal.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.hint.1: Ubheka izindawo ezine ze-decimal, maka lapho ukuphindeka kuqala khona.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.r.a: Ucabange nge-0.1666…. Indawo yokuqala ngu-1, futhi u-6 uphindeka kusukela endaweni yesibili.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.r.b: Ucabange nge-0.111…. Ukuphindeka kuqala ngqo endaweni yokuqala.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.r.c: Ucabange nge-0.05. Le decimal iyaphela futhi ayiphindeki.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.r.d: Ucabange nge-0.08333…. U-3 uphindeka kusukela endaweni yesithathu.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.r.e: Ucabange nge-0.142857…. U-142857 uphindeka kusukela endaweni yokuqala.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.explain: 1/6 = 0.1666… no-1/12 = 0.08333… banezindawo ngaphambili ezingeyona ingxenye yokuphindeka. U-1/9 no-1/7 baphindeka ngqo kusukela endaweni yokuqala, futhi u-1/20 = 0.05 yi-decimal ephelayo.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izingxenyana ezingu-3 ezihlukile u-a/b (u-a no-b yizinombolo zemvelo, a < b ≤ 60) eziqhubeka unomphela uma zibhalwe njenge-decimal futhi ukuphindeka kwazo kuqala ngemuva kwendawo yokuqala ye-decimal, hhayi kuyo. (Izingxenyana ezinenani elifanayo zibalwa njengeyodwa. Isibonelo: 1/6 no-2/12 bayafana.)
y-m-23-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ingxenyana ngayinye njenge-decimal linye ngesikhathi futhi uqoqe ethebuleni lapho ukuphindeka kuqala khona.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.hint.1: Zihlukanise zibe amaqembu amabili, lezo ezibuyela ngokushesha nalezo ezibuyela sekwephuzile, futhi uqhathanise abahlukanisi.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.ok.c1: U-a uyinombolo yemvelo engu-1 noma ngaphezulu futhi a < b ≤ 60.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Sicela wenze u-a no-b babe yizinombolo zemvelo ezinoa < b ≤ 60.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Iyinombolo ephela uma ibhalwe njenge-decimal. Khetha ingxenyana eqhubeka unomphela.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Ukuphindeka kuqala ngemuva kwendawo yokuqala, hhayi kuyo.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Ukuphindeka kuqala ngqo kusukela endaweni yokuqala ye-decimal. Funa inombolo enezindawo ngaphambili ezingeyona ingxenye yokuphindeka.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.explain: 1/6 = 0.1666…, 1/12 = 0.08333…, 1/15 = 0.0666…, 7/30 = 0.2333…, no-1/14 = 0.0714285714285… bonke banezindawo ngaphambili ezingeyona ingxenye yokuphindeka. Wonke amacala lapho, ngemibandela emincane, okuhlukanisayo kunengu-2 noma 5 futhi kunesici esiyinhloko ngaphandle kuka-2 no-5 kuyafaneleka.

y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Yehlisa izingxenyana owazenzile zibe yimibandela emincane futhi uhlele abahlukanisi bazo ndawonye.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Beka eceleni kwabahlukanisi bezingxenyana ezibuyela ngokushesha futhi uthole umehluko.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ubona isici esifanayo esivamile kuzo zonke izingxenyana owazenzile?
y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Isiqagelo sakho sika-'kungani' sixhumene nobufakazi (isibonelo, isimo sokuhlukanisayo samanani ama-decimal aphelayo)?
y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.model.0: Okuhlukanisayo kunengu-2 noma 5 futhi kunenye inombolo njengo-3. U-6, 12, 15, no-30 bonke banjalo. Uma kunengu-2 no-5 kuphela iyaphela, futhi uma kunengu-3 kuphela iyaphindeka ngokushesha, ngakho uma izinhlobo ezimbili zixutshiwe, ingxenye yangaphambili iyaphela futhi engemuva iyaphindeka, kubonakala.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.model.1: Njengo-6, 14, 15, bayimiphindaphindo ka-2 noma 5 futhi nayimiphindaphindo ka-3 noma 7. Izinhlobo ezimbili zixutshiwe, ngakho ingxenye yangaphambili iyaphela futhi engemuva iyaphindeka.
